name: bk_exp22_rows
title: Exp 22: the control row is the one the NLA states, Oracle Lens exhibits and the J-lens reads
caption: Exp 22 (public rebuild, 8 rows incl. Python-vs-JavaScript control): each panel is one pre-registered cell; markers show the observed value per row, triangle up/down = predicted high/low, dashed line = the declared 'counts as high' threshold; filled in the reader's colour when the prediction held, open dark when it missed. Horizontal bars on the three judged cells are item-clustered bootstrap 95% intervals (320 readouts, 40 items); the AUROC cells have no per-item scores stored, so no interval. 'NLA complement (multi-choice)' is the pre-registered cell 'NLA names the complement': a multi-candidate forced-choice argmax on the unmarked value, not a regex or judge verdict. Grey J-lens markers are lexically cued rows, excluded from the primary scorecard as declared (still counted in the all-cells total).

checks.quantity: exp 22 judged-cell observed values recomputed from per-readout verdicts

notes: Observed-high verified as observed >= feature_spec CELL_THRESH for every cell. Exp 19 items never read beyond verdict flags; no item text plotted.
